name: lines_before
sql: select round(extract(epoch from (clock_timestamp() - now())) * 1000) ms from (select drops_api.snapshot(72) j) s

name: install_lines_guarded
sql_tail: do $g$ declare t0 timestamptz := clock_timestamp(); d interval; begin perform drops_api.snapshot(72); d := clock_timestamp() - t0; if d > interval '10 seconds' then raise exception 'drops_api.snapshot(72) took % with the new lines(): rolled back (limit 10 s, reader timeout 20 s)', d; end if; end $g$;

name: lines_grants
sql: select 1 where not has_function_privilege('anon', 'drops_api.lines(integer)', 'execute') and not has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'drops_api.lines(integer)', 'execute')

name: lines_books
sql: select b from (select drops_api.lines(72) l) x, jsonb_array_elements(x.l) e, jsonb_object_keys(e->'books') b group by b

name: lines_with_polymarket
sql: select 1 from (select drops_api.lines(72) l) x, jsonb_array_elements(x.l) e where e->'books' ? 'Polymarket'

name: lines_with_kalshi
sql: select 1 from (select drops_api.lines(72) l) x, jsonb_array_elements(x.l) e where e->'books' ? 'Kalshi'

name: lines_after
sql: select round(extract(epoch from (clock_timestamp() - now())) * 1000) ms from (select drops_api.snapshot(72) j) s
